text:
Your advisor is not a mind reader.
Send the email.
Grad school tip: before you open your laptop, write down the one thing that would make today a good research day. Do that first, even if it only takes 25 minutes.

Nobody tells you this in your first year: confusion is not a sign that you are in the wrong program. It is the job.

Every result you will ever be proud of started as a page of questions you could not answer yet. Write the questions down, date them, and come back in a month. You will be surprised how many you can answer.
